metadata.question: Did did the total rainfall exceed 6 inches in Grafton, New South Wales during January 14, 2020 to January 22, 2020?

data.raw_code:
<thinking>
1. Search strategy: Use CHIRPS Daily precipitation (mm/day) for 2020-01-14 to 2020-01-23 (end exclusive) over a 10 km buffer around Grafton, NSW (-29.691, 152.934). If empty, fallback to ERA5-Land Daily Aggregated precipitation (converted from m/day to mm/day).
2. Masking strategy: Not applicable for precipitation datasets (no cloud masking). Use valid-pixel count to verify data presence.
3. Logic: If collections empty -> C1. If valid pixel count after region reduction is 0 -> C2. If region mean is null/NaN or negative -> C3. Otherwise compare total rainfall (mm) > 152.4 mm (6 inches) to output A or B.
</thinking>

<code>
```javascript
const ee = require('@google/earthengine');
const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7');

async function runAnalysis() {
  try {
    // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
    const geom = ee.Geometry.Point([152.9344, -29.6910]).buffer(10000); // Grafton, NSW, 10 km buffer
    const start = '2020-01-14';
    const endExclusive = '2020-01-23'; // include up to 2020-01-22
    const thresholdMM = 152.4; // 6 inches in mm

    // 2. Data Acquisition & Check
    let datasetName = 'CHIRPS_DAILY';
    let col = ee.ImageCollection('UCSB-CHG/CHIRPS/DAILY')
      .filterDate(start, endExclusive)
      .filterBounds(geom)
      .select('precipitation');
    let size1 = col.size().getInfo();

    if (size1 === 0) {
      console.log(`CHIRPS Images: 0`);
      // Fallback: ERA5-Land Daily Aggregated (convert m/day to mm/day)
      datasetName = 'ERA5_LAND_DAILY';
      let col2 = ee.ImageCollection('ECMWF/ERA5_LAND/DAILY_AGGR')
        .filterDate(start, endExclusive)
        .filterBounds(geom)
        .select('total_precipitation_sum')
        .map(function(img) {
          return img.multiply(1000).rename('precipitation').copyProperties(img, img.propertyNames());
        });
      let size2 = col2.size().getInfo();
      if (size2 === 0) {
        console.log(`ERA5-LAND Images: 0`);
        console.log('C1');
        return;
      }
      console.log(`ERA5-LAND Images: ${size2}`);
      col = col2;
    } else {
      console.log(`CHIRPS Images: ${size1}`);
    }

    // 3. Processing
    // Sum daily precipitation over the period -> total precipitation (mm)
    const totalImg = col.sum().rename('precip_mm');

    // Valid pixel count
    const countDict = totalImg.reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
      geometry: geom,
      scale: 5000,
      maxPixels: 1e9
    });
    const validCount = countDict.get('precip_mm').getInfo();

    if (validCount === null || validCount === 0) {
      console.log(`Valid pixels: ${validCount || 0}`);
      console.log('C2');
      return;
    }

    // 4. Calculation
    const meanDict = totalImg.reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(),
      geometry: geom,
      scale: 5000,
      maxPixels: 1e9
    });
    const totalMM = meanDict.get('precip_mm').getInfo();

    // 5. Validation & Final Answer
    if (totalMM === null || isNaN(totalMM) || totalMM < 0) {
      console.log(`Valid pixels: ${validCount}`);
      console.log(`Total rainfall (area-avg): ${totalMM}`);
      console.log('C3');
      return;
    }

    const totalIn = totalMM / 25.4;
    console.log(`Dataset: ${datasetName}`);
    console.log(`Valid pixels: ${validCount}`);
    console.log(`Total rainfall (area-avg): ${totalMM.toFixed(2)} mm (${totalIn.toFixed(2)} in)`);
    console.log(`Threshold: ${thresholdMM.toFixed(2)} mm (6.00 in)`);

    if (totalMM > thresholdMM) {
      console.log('A');
    } else {
      console.log('B');
    }
  } catch (err) {
    console.log('D');
  }
}

async function initEE() {
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject);
  });
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject);
  });
  await runAnalysis();
}

initEE();
```
